acme net balance is 62169 cents. Next I will fetch net_balance for birch and cobalt to ensure correct figures before recording payouts.
birch net balance is 48740 cents. Now I will get cobalt's net balance.

Alpha reports refunds applied for order_ids 272 and 274; net_balance for customers acme, birch, cobalt is available and reflects correct post-refund totals. I will now record one payout per customer equal to their net_balance.
